liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Wattchtower**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [11]
- **China Cat**: rare: 5 archived performances [11]
- **Casey Jones fixed**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [11]

## The recordings

- **deadco2022-07-10** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 195 min; rated 4.75/5 by 4 [1]
- **deadco2022-07-10.CitizensBankParkPhiladelphiaPA**: audience recording; 19 songs; 194 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer had to work on the sound, then rated the result very highly [10]
- **deadco2022-07-10.ps1.s2.omt8audmtx.perez.t-flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 18 songs; 157 min [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says this venue is challenging for taping, and the taper secured a prime spot [4]
- Reviewer noticed microphones set up down in the pit during the show [7]
- Reviewer noticed microphones set up down in the pit during the show [8]
- Mics were placed inside the soundboard cage left of the board, 12 feet high. Lineup: Weir, Mayer, Burbridge [2]

## Tapers and lineage

- **deadco2022-07-10**: taped by Jeff Travitz [1]
- **deadco2022-07-10.CitizensBankParkPhiladelphiaPA**: taped by JT/NY; transferred by JT/NY; source: Aud > Schoeps CCM 41's > Zoom F6 @ 32 / 48 [2]. Also: Audience source: Schoeps CCM 41 mics into Zoom F6 at 32-bit/48k; edited in Sound Forge 16, converted to FLAC with Traders Little Helper [2]
- **deadco2022-07-10.ps1.s2.omt8audmtx.perez.t-flac16**: taped by David Perez; source: Source: OMT8 AUD MTX (24/44.1) Channels 1|2: Studio Projects C4 (hyper), split 2' @ 45 degrees -> Naiant MidBox -> Tascam DR-680MKII Channel 3|4: Tascam PE-125… [3]. Also: Eight-channel matrix: Studio Projects C4, Tascam PE-125 with JVC caps, Audio Technica 853Rx and AT3031 mics, recorded to Tascam DR-680MKII; The 853Rx omni pair, through an Edirol UA-5, was used for Set II only; transfer went SDHC to WAV to Audacity [3]
